# TextSpanDescriptor

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides fluent styling methods for a text span within a `TextDescriptor`.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Methods

- [`BackgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Sets the background highlight color.
- [`BaselineShift`](#baselineshift): Sets an explicit baseline shift in points (positive = up).
- [`Bold`](#bold): Sets the font weight to bold.
- [`DecorationColor`](#decorationcolor): Sets the decoration line colour (underline/strikethrough/overline).
- [`DecorationLineStyle`](#decorationlinestyle): Sets the decoration line style (solid/wavy/dashed/dotted).
- [`DecorationThickness`](#decorationthickness): Sets the decoration line thickness in points.
- [`FontColor`](#fontcolor): Sets the text color.
- [`FontFamily`](#fontfamily): Sets the font family.
- [`FontSize`](#fontsize): Sets the font size in points.
- [`Italic`](#italic): Sets italic rendering.
- [`LetterSpacing`](#letterspacing): Sets letter spacing (tracking) in points, added after every glyph.
- [`Overline`](#overline): Adds overline decoration (a line above the text).
- [`Strikethrough`](#strikethrough): Adds strikethrough decoration.
- [`Subscript`](#subscript): Lowers the span below the baseline (subscript).
- [`Superscript`](#superscript): Raises the span above the baseline (superscript).
- [`Underline`](#underline): Adds underline decoration.
- [`WavyUnderline`](#wavyunderline): Adds a wavy underline (spell-check style).
- [`Weight`](#weight): Sets the font weight.
- [`WordSpacing`](#wordspacing): Sets word spacing in points, added after every space.
